texts: Whenever an equinox passes, Aron Brae makes vessels.
Traders from Faltern and the inland farms come to the market each week.

fields.sentence: Whenever an equinox passes, Aron Brae makes vessels.
parse: (: lo85_rule (Implication (And (Member $x pass) (Patient $x $y) (Member $y equinox)) (And (Member (sk_make $x) make) (Agent (sk_make $x) aron_brae) (Patient (sk_make $x) vessel) (During (sk_make $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: The whenever machinery, plain-variable premise, Skolem-function consequent with During, absent QuantifierPhrase and 1.0/0.9 rule TV all match the 'Every time the bell rings' template; the Name atom sits at top level outside the rule as a label should. Patient on the passing equinox follows the intransitive-subject test for a non-volitional occurrence.

fields.sentence: Traders from Faltern and the inland farms come to the market each week.
parse: (: trader_faltern_rule (Implication (And (Member $x trader) (From $x faltern)) (And (Member (sk_come $x) come) (Agent (sk_come $x) $x) (Goal (sk_come $x) sk_market_1) (Every (sk_come $x) 1 week))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

(: trader_farms_rule (Implication (And (Member $x trader) (From $x sk_farms_1)) (And (Member (sk_come $x) come) (Agent (sk_come $x) $x) (Goal (sk_come $x) sk_market_1) (Every (sk_come $x) 1 week))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

review.notes: The coordinated origin restriction is correctly split into one rule per conjunct (a disjunctive premise range), with entity-attached From for origin, Goal for the non-recipient destination, Every 1 week for the periodic frequency and no QuantifierPhrase companion. The inland_farm compound exposes its positional modifier genus as the east_wing pattern requires, and the definite plural takes a group witness in the group's kind slot.
